criteria.question: does a loom burst on the loom-sensitive LC types fire the giant fiber (DNp01) with published probability, count and latency, drive TTMn one to one through the electrical GF -> TTMn synapse, leave the CNS quiet, and fail on a rewired null?

protocol.trials_note: canonical trial count per arm (the script's default argument is 20; a run at fewer is flagged TRIALS by summarize)
protocol.stimulus: flycns.protocols.loom_protocol: 60 ms flat-rate burst on the LOOM_TUNING types, 300 ms gaps, per-trial lognormal gain at the declared GAIN_SIGMA_DEFAULT and PEAK_HZ_DEFAULT
protocol.window_ms: burst onset to onset + 60 ms burst + 100 ms
protocol.seeds: the declared default seed (LIFParams().seed) for the network and for the per-trial loom gains, the same in every arm

gf_spikes_per_response_1_to_2.rule: PASS if the 95% bootstrap interval of GF spikes per firing GF cell, over responding trials, lies within 1 to 2

gf_response_prob_0.5_to_1.rule: PASS if the Wilson 95% interval of the fraction of trials with any GF spike lies within 0.5 to 1

gf_latency_10_60ms.rule: PASS if the 95% bootstrap interval of first-GF-spike latency after burst onset lies within 10 to 60 ms

ttmn_one_to_one.rule: PASS if the 95% bootstrap interval of sum(TTMn spikes per cell) / sum(GF spikes per cell) lies within 0.8 to 1.2

ttmn_lag_0.5_1.5ms.rule: PASS if the 95% bootstrap interval of first TTMn spike minus first GF spike lies within 0.5 to 1.5 ms

cns_quiet.rule: PASS if the whole-run population rate of the real+electrical arm is below 0.05 Hz per neuron (one number with no trial structure, scored on its point value)

electrical_necessary.condition: scored when the real+electrical arm fires TTMn spikes; otherwise UNRESOLVED (nothing to abolish)
electrical_necessary.rule: PASS if the 95% interval of (chemical-only TTMn per cell - 0.1 x real TTMn per cell), the two arms resampled independently, lies at or below 0; FAIL if above 0

null_silent.rule: PASS if the Wilson 95% interval of the fraction of rewired-null trials with any GF spike lies at or below 0.1

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
